name: Cali Blaze Infused Preroll | Baja Blaze
description:
A bold, refreshing blend inspired by the flavors of Baja California. Citrus-forward with tropical undertones, this hybrid delivers a smooth, invigorating smoke that keeps you coming back for more.

Infused with Liquid Diamonds: THC-A diamonds liquified for a clean, high-potency infusion. Clean, clear-headed potency — no muddled high.
